Identity and homelands

Cahto, also written Kato, is associated with the Cahto Tribe of the Laytonville Rancheria in northern California.

Read the sources [1] Cahto Tribe

02

Historical context

The Tribe’s introduction explains the Long Valley villages and the name Tlokyáhan, “Grass People,” alongside the name Cahto.

Read the sources [1] Cahto Tribe

03

Living communities and further study

Its public introduction discusses homeland, language loss, and cultural symbols. The government home page provides access to the present tribal institution.
